hooks.name: ghost-gate (shell)
hooks.description: Rehearses shell commands in a sealed copy before they run. Ships disabled; `corepack pnpm gate:on` switches it on and `corepack pnpm gate:off` switches it off.

hooks.name: ghost-gate (write)
hooks.description: Judges file writes against the wards before they happen. Ships disabled; `corepack pnpm gate:on` switches it on and `corepack pnpm gate:off` switches it off.
